svg.text: Every Thursday RAA becomes a stage for short performances, stage experiments,
ideas, miniatures, voice or reading performances, other kinds of acts. These don't
have to be fully produced pieces, but they should also not be impromptu open-mics.
Instead these are sketches of ideas, some with a dramaturgy, others less so. Can be
groups, can be individual, can be non-human. The program is finalized 10 days before
the event. If you want to participate, send us an outline of your idea and the date
where you would like to be placed.
